tagline: What is new in the changelog tool

entries.title: Multilingual entries
entries.body: Entries can now carry per-language titles and bodies; the end-user page and the in-app modals render in the reader's language.

bodyByLang.es: Las entradas ahora pueden tener títulos y cuerpos por idioma; la página y los modales se muestran en el idioma del usuario.
bodyByLang.en: Entries can now carry per-language titles and bodies; the end-user page and the in-app modals render in the reader's language.

entries.title: Install from either registry
entries.body:
Install `@jfrader/changelog` from npmjs or GitHub Packages. Both registries
receive the same verified release artifact.

titleByLang.es: Instalalo desde cualquiera de los dos registros

bodyByLang.en:
Install `@jfrader/changelog` from npmjs or GitHub Packages. Both registries
receive the same verified release artifact.
bodyByLang.es:
Instalá `@jfrader/changelog` desde npmjs o GitHub Packages. Los dos registros
reciben exactamente el mismo artefacto verificado.

entries.title: First public release
entries.body: Zero-dependency changelog system: markdown entries, an agent-facing MD workflow, a build, a tiny serve backend, and a browser-safe in-app What's New SDK.

bodyByLang.en: Zero-dependency changelog system: markdown entries, an agent-facing MD workflow, a build, a tiny serve backend, and a browser-safe in-app What's New SDK.
